notes: Scope: Pass 3 only (CWE-918 SSRF primary; CWE-099/CWE-610 co-tags per the pass definition).

All pass-3 labels were produced from direct reading of the mindsdb sources in the CodeQL database root; no vulnerability ground truth, CVE descriptions, fix commits or pre-existing SSRF analysis artifacts in the repo root were consulted.

Semantics: role=source marks a genuine untrusted input boundary (flask request fields, REST path variables, SQL text over the HTTP/wire-protocol executor, ML 'using' args); classification encodes the pass-3 verdict (tp / candidate / fp) and Phase 2 library generation should only use source/sink entries whose classification is tp or candidate.
role=none is used for operator-trusted environment-variable boundaries (REGISTRY_URL, MINDSDB_EXECUTOR_URL) - admin-config FP per the pass-3 heuristics.

The SQL text boundaries (request.json['query'] of POST /api/sql/query and analysis, MysqlProxy/PostgresProxy process_query sql) are the dominant source family: CREATE DATABASE ... WITH PARAMETERS, CREATE ML_ENGINE/CREATE MODEL ... USING and SELECT ... FROM web WHERE url reach the outbound-HTTP sinks through the executor and stored connection args.

Sinks split into: 37 tp (attacker-controlled host via connection args / SQL values / REST body: dremio, pinot, strapi, eventstoredb, frappe, sap_erp, lightdash, mlflow, ray_serve, scylla, gmail/youtube credentials_url, rag url, clipdrop image_url, twitter media_url, stabilityai image_url, web-crawl session, files-API requests.get, download_file), 5 candidate (second-order or dead-code-leaning: file_handler._fetch_url, lightwood train_url, eventstoredb link['uri'] x2, frappe redirect Location), 51 fp (fixed provider hosts, config/OAuth hosts, literal S3/IMDS URLs, env-derived URLs).

A pass_id=1 stub block with zero entries is included only to satisfy the schema's 'contains' clause (assets/labels_schema.json requires an element with pass_id=1); Pass 1 is out of scope for this run and has no labeled candidates.

No sanitizer entries were emitted: none of the extracted CSV candidates is a sanitizing API. Partial mitigations found in code (download_file non-empty-scheme check, file_handler/scylla scheme checks, clipdrop extension check, urlcrawl same-domain filter, eventstoredb tls/port isinstance checks) are documented in the relevant entries' rationale/evidence as insufficient (no host allow-list, no private-IP/DNS check, no redirect control anywhere in the tree).

No summary entries were emitted: the extraction deliberately excluded internal wrapper url params (download_file/_fetch_url/get_all_website_links/registry) per detection.json coverage_gaps; the earliest untrusted boundaries were extracted instead, so no additional propagation steps are needed from the CSV candidates.

requests follows redirects by default at every sink site (no allow_redirects setting anywhere except frappe_client.py:63/70), which undermines host-level reasoning even for the config/literal-host sites.

file:/data: URLs are not treated as server-side HTTP requests: no file:/data: fetching exists in this source tree (file_handler restricts to http/https; download_file only requires a non-empty scheme); scheme-permissiveness of download_file is recorded as a cross-protocol concern in its rationale, not merged into the CWE-918 verdicts.
